newsitem.title: USA: General Signal names two top finance execs.
newsitem.headline: General Signal names two top finance execs.

text.p: General Signal Corp said Friday it named Gerry Mortimer as treasurer, replacing Julian Twombly, who was named president of the company's Edward Systems Technology unit in January.
Mortimer, who was previously controller, continues as a vice president, the company said. Before joining General Signal in 1990, he was finance director for Apple Computer Inc .

General Signal said it also named Raymond Arthur as controller and vice president. Arthur joins the company from American Home Products Corp, where he was assistant vice president and director of compliance.
Arthur joined American Home Products in 1994, when it was acquired by American Cyanamid Co, in which he worked beginning in 1986 and where he held senior management positions, it said.
